record_info.statute: Fla. Stat. ch. 560 (Part II); Fla. Stat. 120.60

license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the business of a money services business
license_required.note: Money transmitters are licensed under Part II of ch. 560

bond_structure.quote: The corporate surety bond shall be in an amount as specified by rule
bond_structure.note: Set by rule between $50,000 and $2 million

net_worth_structure.quote: A licensee operating in more than one location must have an additional net worth of $10,000 per location in this state
net_worth_structure.note: $100,000 plus $10,000 per extra Florida location, capped at $2 million

net_worth_min_usd.quote: A licensee must have a net worth of at least $100,000

application_fee_usd.note: Part II covers money transmitters; plus $38 per branch or vendor location

decision_days.quote: An application for a license must be approved or denied within 90 days after receipt of a completed application
decision_days.note: From Florida's general licensing law, not ch. 560; approved by default if late

exemptions.quote: The following entities are exempt from the provisions of this chapter:
exemptions.note: Florida has only three exemptions, far fewer than Texas or Kentucky
